product.vendored_dependency_note: Stability-AI/stablediffusion (the `ldm` package A1111 pins at cf1d67a6fd5ea1aa600c4df58e5b47da45f6bdbf) returns HTTP 404 on GitHub as of 2026-09-20; the exact pinned tree was recovered from Software Heritage swh:1:dir:e950a2c522706eca6ce024985218623a35d2c8e0 and vendored into the image.

attacker_capability: one downloaded model package unpacked into models/Stable-diffusion/ : model.safetensors + model.yaml + hubconf.py. No code is run on the victim machine by us; nothing is imported.
victim_action: select the checkpoint -- driven through the product's own public HTTP API, POST /sdapi/v1/options {"sd_model_checkpoint": "<title>"}
taint_path: modules/sd_models_config.py:117-136 find_checkpoint_config -> find_checkpoint_config_near_filename returns <basename>.yaml (pathname is the only relation checked)
modules/sd_models.py:778-783 get_obj_from_str: importlib.import_module(module) + getattr -- no registry, no allowlist
torch/hub.py load(source='local') -> _load_local -> _import_module('hubconf', <artifact dir>/hubconf.py) -- top-level module code of an attacker-shipped file runs as the WebUI process

negative_control.difference: ONLY the sidecar YAML's model.target string (torch.nn.Identity instead of torch.hub.load). The same hubconf.py payload file is present on disk in the negative package.
negative_control.expectation: the sidecar is read (product log prints 'Creating model from config: models/Stable-diffusion/mbe2e_neg/model.yaml') but no canary is written

notes: repair_config() unconditionally injects use_ema=False, which is why a naive subprocess.run gadget FAILS on the real product path even though it works when instantiate_from_config is called by hand. Any gadget must absorb **kwargs.
--skip-load-model-at-start is used so the ONLY checkpoint load in the whole run is the one the victim's API call triggers; this removes any ambiguity about when the canary was written.
Run time is --network none; torch.hub source='local' means no network is needed at any point.

victim_preconditions.why: 受害者本来就在用这个产品；这是使用前提，不是攻击者能力

victim_preconditions_note: 由 scripts/backfill_preconditions.py 从本目录 Dockerfile 实际执行的步骤推导；任何 realistic:false 的项必须出现在报告的「验证边界」段落。
